mapper.select: select b.id as batchId, h.name as houseName, b.batch_code as batchCode, b.end_date as endDate from batches b inner join rabbit_houses h on h.id = b.house_id where b.house_id = #{houseId} and b.id = #{batchId} limit 1

select count(distinct bc.id) as matedCycleCount, count(distinct bc.mother_rabbit_id) as matedDoeCount, count(distinct case when bc.pregnancy_result = '怀孕' then bc.id end) as pregnantCycleCount, count(distinct case when bc.pregnancy_result = '怀孕' then bc.mother_rabbit_id end) as pregnantDoeCount, count(distinct bc.male_rabbit_id) as matedBuckCount, coalesce(max(case when bc.mating_method = 'NATURAL' and bc.male_rabbit_id is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missingNaturalMale from breeding_cycles bc where bc.house_id = #{houseId} and bc.batch_id = #{batchId} and bc.mating_date is not null

select date(bc.mating_date) as date, count(distinct bc.id) as cycleCount from breeding_cycles bc where bc.house_id = #{houseId} and bc.batch_id = #{batchId} and bc.mating_date is not null group by date(bc.mating_date) order by date(bc.mating_date)

select count(distinct case when bc.batch_id = #{batchId} and bc.pregnancy_result = '怀孕' then e.cycle_id end) as abortedPregnantCycleCount, coalesce(max(case when bc.id is null or bc.batch_id <> #{batchId} or bc.pregnancy_result is null or bc.pregnancy_result <> '怀孕' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missingPregnancyEvidence from repro_events e left join breeding_cycles bc on bc.id = e.cycle_id and bc.house_id = e.house_id where e.house_id = #{houseId} and e.event_type = 'ABORTION' and (e.batch_id = #{batchId} or bc.batch_id = #{batchId})

select count(l.id) as totalLitters, coalesce(sum(l.total_kits), 0) as totalKits, coalesce(sum(l.live_kits), 0) as totalLiveKits, coalesce(sum(case when l.kept_kits > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as keptLitterCount, coalesce(sum(l.kept_kits), 0) as totalKept, coalesce(sum(l.weaned_count), 0) as totalWeaned, coalesce(sum(l.weaning_total_weight_kg), 0) as totalWeaningWeightKg, coalesce(max(case when l.weaned_count > 0 and l.weaning_total_weight_kg is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missingWeaningWeight from litters l where l.house_id = #{houseId} and l.batch_id = #{batchId}

select count(distinct case when i.batch_id_snapshot = #{batchId} then i.rabbit_id end) as soldRabbitCount, coalesce(max(case when i.batch_id_snapshot is null and (r.birth_batch_id = #{batchId} or exists ( select 1 from batch_rabbits historical_br inner join batches historical_b on historical_b.id = historical_br.batch_id and historical_b.house_id = o.house_id where historical_br.rabbit_id = i.rabbit_id and historical_br.batch_id = #{batchId} and historical_br.batch_role = 'fattening' )) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missingBatchAttribution from sale_orders o left join sale_order_items i on i.sale_order_id = o.id left join rabbits r on r.id = i.rabbit_id and r.house_id = o.house_id where o.house_id = #{houseId}

with batch_window as ( select b.id as batch_id, b.house_id, b.end_date, min(bc.mating_date) as first_mating_at from batches b left join breeding_cycles bc on bc.house_id = b.house_id and bc.batch_id = b.id and bc.mating_date is not null where b.house_id = #{houseId} and b.id = #{batchId} group by b.id, b.house_id, b.end_date ), relevant_feed_logs as ( select distinct fl.id, fl.unit from batch_window bw inner join feed_logs fl on fl.house_id = bw.house_id inner join feed_log_rabbits flr on flr.feed_log_id = fl.id and flr.house_id = fl.house_id inner join rabbits r on r.id = flr.rabbit_id and r.house_id = fl.house_id where bw.first_mating_at is not null and fl.feed_time >= date(bw.first_mating_at) and ((bw.end_date is not null and fl.feed_time < date_add(bw.end_date, interval 1 day)) or (bw.end_date is null and fl.feed_time <= now())) and ( (r.type = '2' and r.birth_batch_id = bw.batch_id and r.arrival_date is not null and r.arrival_date <= fl.feed_time) or exists ( select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = bw.batch_id and br.rabbit_id = r.id and br.batch_role = 'fattening' and br.join_date <= fl.feed_time and (br.exit_date is null or br.exit_date >= fl.feed_time) ) or exists ( select 1 from batch_rabbits br where br.batch_id = bw.batch_id and br.rabbit_id = r.id and br.batch_role = 'breeding' and br.join_date <= fl.feed_time and (br.exit_date is null or br.exit_date >= fl.feed_time) and exists ( select 1 from breeding_cycles bc where bc.house_id = bw.house_id and bc.batch_id = br.batch_id and bc.mother_rabbit_id = br.rabbit_id and bc.mating_date <= fl.feed_time ) ) ) union select distinct fl.id, fl.unit from batch_window bw inner join feed_log_batch_allocations a on a.house_id = bw.house_id and a.batch_id = bw.batch_id inner join feed_logs fl on fl.id = a.feed_log_id and fl.house_id = a.house_id where bw.first_mating_at is not null and fl.feed_time >= date(bw.first_mating_at) and ((bw.end_date is not null and fl.feed_time < date_add(bw.end_date, interval 1 day)) or (bw.end_date is null and fl.feed_time <= now())) ) select coalesce(( select sum(a.amount_kg) from feed_log_batch_allocations a inner join feed_logs fl on fl.id = a.feed_log_id and fl.house_id = a.house_id where a.house_id = bw.house_id and a.batch_id = bw.batch_id and a.phase = 'BREEDING' and bw.first_mating_at is not null and fl.feed_time >= date(bw.first_mating_at) and ((bw.end_date is not null and fl.feed_time < date_add(bw.end_date, interval 1 day)) or (bw.end_date is null and fl.feed_time <= now())) ), 0) as breedingFeedAmountKg, coalesce(( select sum(a.amount_kg) from feed_log_batch_allocations a inner join feed_logs fl on fl.id = a.feed_log_id and fl.house_id = a.house_id where a.house_id = bw.house_id and a.batch_id = bw.batch_id and a.phase = 'FATTENING' and bw.first_mating_at is not null and fl.feed_time >= date(bw.first_mating_at) and ((bw.end_date is not null and fl.feed_time < date_add(bw.end_date, interval 1 day)) or (bw.end_date is null and fl.feed_time <= now())) ), 0) as fatteningFeedAmountKg, case when exists ( select 1 from relevant_feed_logs relevant where not exists ( select 1 from feed_log_batch_allocations existing where existing.house_id = bw.house_id and existing.batch_id = bw.batch_id and existing.feed_log_id = relevant.id ) ) then 1 else 0 end as missingFeedAllocation, case when exists ( select 1 from relevant_feed_logs relevant where relevant.unit is null or lower(trim(relevant.unit)) <> 'kg' ) then 1 else 0 end as missingFeedUnit from batch_window bw

select coalesce(( select sum(a.total_weight_kg) from replacement_batch_allocations a where a.house_id = b.house_id and a.source_batch_id = b.id ), 0) as replacementWeightKg, case when exists ( select 1 from replacement_records rr inner join rabbits r on r.id = rr.rabbit_id and r.house_id = rr.house_id where rr.house_id = b.house_id and (r.birth_batch_id = b.id or exists ( select 1 from batch_rabbits historical_br inner join batches historical_b on historical_b.id = historical_br.batch_id and historical_b.house_id = rr.house_id where historical_br.rabbit_id = rr.rabbit_id and historical_br.batch_id = b.id and historical_br.batch_role = 'fattening' and historical_br.join_date <= rr.replacement_date and (historical_br.exit_date is null or historical_br.exit_date >= rr.replacement_date) )) and not exists ( select 1 from replacement_batch_allocations existing where existing.house_id = b.house_id and existing.source_batch_id = b.id and existing.request_id = rr.request_id ) ) or exists ( select 1 from repro_events gap where gap.house_id = b.house_id and gap.batch_id = b.id and gap.target_type = 'BATCH' and gap.target_id = b.id and gap.event_type = 'LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_WEIGHT_GAP' ) then 1 else 0 end as missingReplacementWeight from batches b where b.house_id = #{houseId} and b.id = #{batchId}
